nebc444d578.headline: Borja Prado will leave the presidency of Endesa after the shareholders' meeting in April
nebc444d578.summary: Borja Prado will step down as chairman of Endesa following the shareholders' meeting in April, with re-election proposed but successor not yet announced.
nebc444d578.why: Endesa is a leading Spanish electric utility; leadership changes can influence company strategy and investor confidence.
